x-run-token-policy.issue: Platform/workspace AI on (MADDOTS_AI_OFF); card exists, remains on its original board and is not archived or on an archived board (CARD_LEFT); agent active and On (AGENT_NOT_ON); owner active and can edit (OWNER_LOST_ACCESS); assignment exists from person or scheduler (RUN_UNASSIGNED), with non-Done Review on same board (REVIEW_COLUMN_INVALID); no other live agent run token (AGENT_BUSY); at most 20 issuances per agent per UTC day (TOKEN_LIMIT). Mention checks replace assignment/Review: live person-authored mention for this agent/card/comment (MENTION_DELETED), not stopped (MENTION_STOPPED), not bound to another run (MENTION_ALREADY_RUN), author active and able to edit (MENTION_AUTHOR_LOST_ACCESS); card.left mentions give CARD_LEFT. First issuance binds runId to agentId, cardId, kind, reviewColumnId or commentId, and issueColumnId, with firstIssuedAt. Reissue changing a bound field gets 409 CONFLICT, revokes earlier token, ignores same run for concurrency, preserves issueColumnId/firstIssuedAt and sets expiresAt=min(now+ttl, firstIssuedAt+7200 seconds); every reissue counts toward the daily 20. DELETE durably stops runId even before issuance, retains stopped ids at least 24 hours, and later POST gets 409 CONFLICT.
x-run-token-policy.use: While process switch is on, pm_run_ resolves only through its run binding including revoked rows, never pm_api_ context: an ended mention with retained card.left cause gives 403 CARD_LEFT before the generic revocation check; otherwise unknown or revoked gives 401 TOKEN_REVOKED, expired gives 401 TOKEN_EXPIRED, then each live check gives its own final code; never INVALID_API_TOKEN while on. Every call rechecks platform/workspace AI (MADDOTS_AI_OFF), active agent On (AGENT_NOT_ON), active owner edit rights and binding.ownerUserId equal to current copy owner (OWNER_LOST_ACCESS), original board and unarchived card/board (CARD_LEFT), assignment (RUN_UNASSIGNED) or live mention (MENTION_STOPPED/MENTION_DELETED) and active author edit rights (MENTION_AUTHOR_LOST_ACCESS). Ended card.left mentions give 403 CARD_LEFT on issuance/use. While process switch is off, pm_run_ is not accepted: /api calls give 401 INVALID_API_TOKEN via existing parser; GET /api/run-token gives JSON 404 NOT_FOUND. Both are final. Tokens never appear in owner token lists or count toward owner token cap.
x-run-token-policy.move: POST /api/run-token/move accepts only an empty object and assignment token. Card, Review column and issue column come from binding; MadDots uses current board version. Card no longer in issueColumnId gives 409 CONFLICT without revoking read/comment access. Mention gives 403 MENTION_MOVE_FORBIDDEN. Return only the moved card as data.
x-run-token-policy.comment: All run-token writes replay by (runId, method, path, Idempotency-Key) across every token of the run for at least 7200 seconds. A retry after reissue returns the original result, including the original mention reply instead of MENTION_REPLY_USED. Mention first distinct comment becomes its reply and a second distinct write gives MENTION_REPLY_USED. Assignments may comment repeatedly. Tokens never assign/mention agents, even via trusted MCP dispatch.

classes.final: Stop the AI tool now, never retry: any 401 or 403 from a run-token route, whatever code or body; any 4xx except 429 from GET /api/run-token, including JSON or non-JSON 404; and 404 from GET /api/cards/:id.
classes.retry: Send again with the same Idempotency-Key and body until expiresAt: no answer, connection error or timeout; any JSON or non-JSON 5xx, including nginx 502/504 and Cloudflare 520-530; any 429; and 409 COMMENT_DELIVERY_BUSY.
classes.failed: Any other 4xx on a write fails that operation without retry and the run continues. FILE_TOO_LARGE drops that file; CONFLICT on move leaves the card where it is. Unknown codes are classified by HTTP status under these rules.

x-run-token-policy.routeRefusals: :id is the bound card or an attachment on it. Assignment tokens only may POST /api/run-token/move; mention tokens receive 403 MENTION_MOVE_FORBIDDEN. Every other route (other /api routes, /mcp, OAuth, live sync, /ai-engine/v1/* and browser calls 11/13) gives 403 API_ROUTE_FORBIDDEN. Another card or attachment id gives 404 NOT_FOUND. GET /api/run-token with any other credential gives 401 UNAUTHENTICATED.
